query:
SELECT library_items.kind AS "kind?: ItemKind", (SELECT json_group_object(namespace, value) FROM item_match_ids
              WHERE item_match_ids.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND scope = 'title') AS "ids?: String", (SELECT json_group_object(namespace, value) FROM item_match_ids
              WHERE item_match_ids.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND scope = 'show') AS "show_ids?: String", libraries.title_sources
                       FROM library_files
                       JOIN libraries ON libraries.id = library_files.library_id
                       LEFT JOIN library_items ON library_items.file_id = library_files.id
                       LEFT JOIN item_matches ON item_matches.item_id = library_items.id
                                             AND item_matches.state = 'matched'
                       WHERE library_files.id = ?
                       ORDER BY library_items.season, library_items.episode
